entities.summary: Antonio Tarsia was an Italian sculptor. He was born in Venice and was one of the most active Venetian sculptors in the early 18th century. Tarsia was mentor and father-in-law to sculptor Antonio Corradini. He died on 10 December 1739 in Venice.
